security/Proofs.why: Each of its theorems is one kernel computation over four rows of the test noise's G, whose state the kernel holds until it ends. The file checks them one after another; the replay checks each declaration as a task of its own, so in the whole replay they are held side by side. In a step of its own at most `threads` of them are.
As Noise.Gram: each of its theorems is one kernel computation over sixteen noise lines of the test noise's F_A.
As Noise.Gram: each of its theorems is one kernel computation over sixteen noise lines of the test noise's F_B.
